name: trace_symbol
description: Inspect constant values and find hardcoded copies. Read-only analysis, not for editing. For function impact, use impact_analysis.

workspace_dir.description: REQUIRED: Absolute path to the project root directory. Call reindex first.

file.description: File path relative to workspace_dir where the symbol is defined (e.g. "src/config.py")

include_literals.description: Search for hardcoded literal values across the project (default: false, slower)
